method: canonical f32 PCM dumped from the native twin and the canonical WASM anchor (WAMR classic interp); element-wise f32 delta; identity recorded as the exact hashes the gate compares (full decode, suffix, seek suffix); fixture set machine-derived from manifests (tolerated families mp3/aac + exact families vorbis/opus)

tolerance_allowed.gate_note: a tolerated case passes only if current native and current anchor hashes equal the identity recorded here AND the runtime is bit-identical to the anchor AND numeric delta <= bound

wasm_anchor.contract: every non-anchor WASM runtime must be bit-identical to the anchor on every tolerance-allowed stream
